historical_input.meaning: comparison workload only; not a production budget

rules: no READY or READING mutation by simulation
no FREE means skip publication without a simulation stall

shedding_ladder: retain previous complete world buffer and reduce world cadence

services.input: edge accumulation; every legal corpus edge preserved
services.audio: priority-0 service observed under maximum proxy presentation load

timing.instrument: R0-E-local, read-only VIC-II-compatible raster low-byte observation
timing.register: $D012 read only through the LLVM-MOS MEGA65 header

resultEncoding.caseBytes: byte 4 raw-q50, byte 5 raw-q95, byte 6 raw-maximum, byte 7 raw-minimum
resultEncoding.ordering: numeric ordering of raw modulo bytes only; it is not an elapsed-time percentile or worst-case ordering when a wrap may occur

limitations: not an input or audio latency result
a zero or nonzero modulo value cannot exclude a 256-line wrap
raw-byte q50/q95/maximum are not elapsed-time p50/p95/worst claims
Xemu observation is not physical-MEGA65 evidence
no DMA or IRQ measurement is performed

d81.predecessor: F65R0E.D81 is historical functional-proxy evidence only; it passed the same-card one-extent control; F65R0E2.D81 and F65R0E3.D81 are invalid after physical chooser ERROR CODE FF and must not be reused
d81.blocker: R0-E4 is not assigned; any authorized new carrier must pass the corrected source/copy-hash, one-extent, post-rename, and safe-eject gate
